title: Bam’s pa hopes Leni will run in 2028
summary: The father of Sen. Bam Aquino still hopes Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo will change her mind and run for president in 2028 – even if his son emerged in a recent survey as the preferred…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The father of Sen. Bam Aquino still hopes Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo will change her mind and run for president in 2028 – even if his son emerged in a recent survey as the preferred opposition bet if Robredo doesn’t run.
Robredo has said she is not running for national office in 2028.
“I will not run for president. I definitely will not run,” she told local reporters in Bicolano in an interview Nov. 9 after the flag-raising ceremony at Naga City Hall.
But Paul Aquino, who ran his sister-in-law Corazon Aquino’s presidential campaign in the snap elections of 1986, said he still is rooting for the former vice president.
“I still hope Leni changes her mind. She is a sure win,” the elder Aquino told this writer in a phone interview yesterday.

According to published sources citing a new Tangere survey, Bam Aquino has emerged as the leading opposition presidential contender in hypothetical 2028 election matchups following Robredo’s decision not to seek a national post.
Tangere is a Philippine market research platform and mobile survey app that regularly releases non-commissioned voter preference polls.
Paul Aquino is the youngest brother of martyred senator Benigno Aquino Jr., whose 94th birth anniversary will be marked on Nov. 27, and uncle of the late former president Noynoy Aquino.
